an10.225-228:1.1: Dasahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati . . . akhataṃ
an10.225-228:1.2: anupahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati . . . vīsatiyā bhikkhave . . . tiṃsāya bhikkhave . . . cattārīsāya bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato khataṃ upahataṃ attānaṃ pariharati . . . akhataṃ anupahataṃ attānam pariharati. Dasahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato idh' ekacco kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati . . . pe . . . idh' ekacco kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati . . .
an10.225-228:1.5: cattārīsāya bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato idh' ekacco kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati . . . idh' ekacco kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati . . . pe . . .
